universal.name: Command Re-roll
universal.when: Just after making a D6 roll
universal.effect: Re-roll that dice. Each dice may only be re-rolled once.

universal.name: Rapid Ingress
universal.effect: One friendly unit currently in Reserves moves onto the battlefield as if it were your Movement phase. It cannot charge this turn.
universal.restriction: Cannot arrive within Engagement Range of any enemy unit

universal.name: Heroic Intervention
universal.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit ends a Charge move
universal.effect: One friendly CHARACTER unit within 3" of that enemy unit can move up to 3", ending closer to or within Engagement Range of an enemy.
universal.restriction: CHARACTER must not already be in Engagement Range of an enemy

universal.name: Grenade
universal.when: Your Shooting phase, before a unit shoots
universal.effect: One model in that unit makes one attack with a Grenade weapon instead of shooting any of its other weapons.
universal.restriction: Model must be equipped with a Grenade weapon. Cannot be used during Overwatch.

universal.name: Overwatch
universal.when: Opponent's Movement or Charge phase, when an enemy unit is selected to move
universal.effect: One friendly unit can shoot at the moving enemy unit. Only unmodified hit rolls of 6 score hits.
universal.restriction: Friendly unit must be visible to and within range of the enemy, and not in Engagement Range of any enemy

universal.name: Go to Ground
universal.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected as a target
universal.effect: Until end of phase, that unit gets +1 to its Armour Save characteristic.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Strategy
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Gladius Task Force Battleline unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, improve the AP of that unit's ranged weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly unit is targeted by attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, improve the AP of all attacks that target that unit by 1 (e.g. AP-2 becomes AP-1) for the purposes of that unit's saving throws.

stratagems.name: Wisdom of the Ancients
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Dreadnought unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, one other friendly unit within range of that Dreadnought's Aura ability also benefits from it.

stratagems.name: Honour the Chapter
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: That unit can fight before it is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Vengeance of Ultramar
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a friendly unit
stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly Adeptus Astartes unit within 6" of the destroyed unit. Until end of phase, each time that unit makes a melee attack against the enemy unit that caused the destruction, re-roll wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Transhuman Physiology
stratagems.when: Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time an attack targets that unit, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails, regardless of any abilities.
stratagems.restriction: Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Biker units only

stratagems.name: Fury of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a Vehicle unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit ignores any penalties to its hit rolls and its ranged weapons do not suffer the effects of any damage table entries.

stratagems.name: Point-blank Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit's ranged weapons can target enemy units within Engagement Range of it.
stratagems.restriction: Cannot target a unit your own unit is in Engagement Range of

stratagems.name: Armoured Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, after a Vehicle unit Advances
stratagems.effect: That unit can still shoot this turn as if it had not moved, but cannot shoot Heavy weapons at their full Ballistic Skill.

stratagems.name: Steel Behemoth
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a Vehicle unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit's Melee weapons have +1 Strength and +1 Damage.
stratagems.restriction: Vehicle units only. Cannot be used on a unit that has already fought this phase.

stratagems.name: Cogitator Targeting Link
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly Vehicle unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Select one other friendly Ironstorm Spearhead Vehicle unit within 6". It can re-roll hit rolls when targeting the same enemy unit this phase.
stratagems.restriction: Both units must be Vehicle units

stratagems.name: Orbital Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, once per battle
stratagems.effect: Pick a point on the battlefield. Every unit within 6" of that point suffers D6 mortal wounds (roll separately for each unit).

stratagems.name: Red Rampage
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a friendly unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Descent of Angels
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before making a Charge roll
stratagems.effect: A Blood Angels unit that arrived from Reserves this turn can declare a Charge. Re-roll that unit's Charge roll.

stratagems.name: The Red Thirst
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, re-roll all failed wound rolls for that unit's melee attacks.
stratagems.restriction: Blood Angels units only. Cannot be used on a unit that has already fought this phase.

stratagems.name: Upon Wings of Fire
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: One Blood Angels Jump Pack unit that Fell Back this turn can still declare a Charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Only in Death Does Duty End
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHARACTER is destroyed by an enemy attack
stratagems.effect: That CHARACTER can fight before it is removed from the battlefield, even if it has already fought this phase.

stratagems.name: Death from Above
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a Jump Pack unit declares a Charge
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time that unit makes a melee attack on the turn it charges, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics.

stratagems.name: Forewarned
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to move
stratagems.effect: One Aeldari unit can shoot at that enemy unit. Unlike Overwatch, this attack uses the unit's normal Ballistic Skill.
stratagems.restriction: Aeldari unit must be in range and not in Engagement Range of any enemy

stratagems.name: Phantasmal Blur
stratagems.when: Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, subtract 1 from hit rolls made against that unit.

stratagems.name: Webway Strike
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: Remove one Aeldari Infantry unit from the battlefield and place it into Webway Reserves. At the start of any of your future Movement phases, it can arrive anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from any enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Infantry units only. Cannot be used once the unit has been placed in reserves once.

stratagems.name: Lightning-fast Reflexes
stratagems.when: Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, improve the invulnerable save of that unit by 1 (e.g. 5+ becomes 4+).
stratagems.restriction: Aeldari units with an invulnerable save only

stratagems.name: Conceal
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit counts as being in cover, even if it is not.

stratagems.name: Runes of Fortune
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Farseer or Warlock unit. That unit can use one additional psychic ability this turn.

stratagems.name: Warriors of the Shrines
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before an Aspect Warrior unit moves
stratagems.effect: That unit can Advance and still shoot or charge this turn. In addition, add 3" to the unit's Advance roll.

stratagems.name: Exarch's Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one Aspect Warrior unit with an Exarch model. Until the start of your next Command phase, double the range of that Exarch's aura abilities.
stratagems.restriction: Aspect Warrior units with an Exarch only

stratagems.name: Death of a Thousand Cuts
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before an Aspect Warrior unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Phoenix Rising
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a Phoenix Lord CHARACTER is destroyed
stratagems.effect: That Phoenix Lord can fight before being removed from the battlefield and, if it destroys the attacking enemy unit, it is placed in Reserves instead of being removed.

stratagems.name: Swift and Deadly
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when an Aspect Warrior unit declares a Charge
stratagems.effect: Add 2 to that unit's Charge roll. If the Charge is successful, that unit fights first in the Fight phase this turn.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Shrine
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an Aspect Warrior unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, improve the AP of all melee weapons that models in that unit are equipped with by 1.

stratagems.name: Emergency Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Necron unit that has not yet used Reanimation Protocols this phase. That unit immediately benefits from Reanimation Protocols as if it were the start of your Command phase.
stratagems.restriction: Necron units with Reanimation Protocols only

stratagems.name: Disruption Fields
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a friendly unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's melee attacks against Vehicle and Monster units.

stratagems.name: My Will Be Done
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Noble unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, friendly Core units within 6" of that Noble add 1 to their hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Horror
stratagems.when: Any Battle Shock test made for an enemy unit within 24" of a Necron unit
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must re-roll its Battle Shock test.
stratagems.restriction: Can only be used once per turn

stratagems.name: Entropic Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a Necron unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack with a Gauss weapon, improve the AP by 1 and that attack ignores invulnerable saves.

stratagems.name: We Are Eternal
stratagems.when: When a Necron unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 4+, that unit is returned to Reserves with half its starting number of models and can return to the battlefield using Rapid Ingress.
stratagems.restriction: Infantry units only. Once per battle per unit.

stratagems.name: WAAAGH!
stratagems.when: Once per battle, at the start of your turn
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your turn, all friendly Ork units add 1 to their Attacks characteristic and add 1 to all Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: 'Ere We Go!
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when an Ork unit declares a Charge
stratagems.effect: Re-roll that unit's Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before an Ork unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Mob Rule
stratagems.when: Battle Shock step of your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Ork unit that failed a Battle Shock test. That unit uses the Leadership characteristic of the nearest friendly Ork unit within 6" instead of its own.

stratagems.name: Kunnin' But Brutal
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an Ork unit is chosen to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit fights before any unit that has not Charged or Heroically Intervened this turn, unless that unit also has this ability.

stratagems.name: Ramming Speed!
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, after an Ork Vehicle unit ends a Charge move
stratagems.effect: Roll one D3. The enemy unit that was Charged suffers that many mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Imperative
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Synapse unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, one additional unit within 12" of that Synapse unit benefits from its Synapse Link ability.

stratagems.name: Voracious Appetite
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, re-roll all failed wound rolls for that unit's melee attacks.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranid units only. Cannot be used on a unit that has already fought this phase.

stratagems.name: Metabolic Overdrive
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before a unit moves
stratagems.effect: That unit can Advance and still declare a Charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Acid Blood
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly unit loses one or more wounds to melee attacks
stratagems.effect: The attacking enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranid units only. Can only be used once per phase.

stratagems.name: Lurk in the Shadows
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, before a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit counts as being in cover and cannot be targeted by weapons with the Ignores Cover ability.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranid Infantry units only. Unit must not have moved this turn.

stratagems.name: The Swarm Descends
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to Charge rolls for all friendly Tyranid units. In addition, each time a friendly unit successfully Charges this phase, it can make a free Pile-in move of up to 3" before attacking.
stratagems.restriction: Tyranid units only. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Death to the False Emperor!
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a Heretic Astartes unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Malicious Volleys
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, Rapid Fire weapons that models in that unit are equipped with have their Rapid Fire value doubled.

stratagems.name: Veterans of the Long War
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, before a unit makes attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's attacks against Adeptus Astartes units.

stratagems.name: Dark Pact
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Chaos unit. Until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of models in that unit. However, at the start of your next Command phase, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Warp Surge
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a Daemon unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to wound rolls for all attacks made by models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Apoplectic Frenzy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, after a friendly unit has fought
stratagems.effect: That unit can fight a second time. All hit rolls for this second fight are made at -1.
stratagems.restriction: Heretic Astartes units only. Cannot be used if the unit is below half strength.

stratagems.name: Contagion Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, before a unit makes attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, an unmodified wound roll of 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

stratagems.name: Cloud of Flies
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected as a target
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, subtract 1 from hit rolls made against that unit.

stratagems.name: Disgustingly Resilient
stratagems.when: Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each time a model in that unit would lose a wound, roll one D6. On a 5+, that wound is not lost.

stratagems.name: Curse of the Leper
stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a Death Guard unit fights
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of enemy units targeted by that unit's melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Walking Plague
stratagems.when: End of any phase
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 3" of a friendly Death Guard unit. Roll one D3. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers that many mortal wounds.
stratagems.restriction: Can only be used once per phase

stratagems.name: Plague Wind
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a Death Guard unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, ranged attacks made by that unit have the Lethal Hits and Devastating Wounds abilities.
stratagems.restriction: Death Guard units only. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: Volley Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before an Infantry unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit can shoot twice, but must target the same enemy unit with all attacks and cannot move this turn if it hasn't already.
stratagems.restriction: Astra Militarum Infantry units that did not move this turn

stratagems.name: Take Cover!
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly unit is selected as a target
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to Armour Save rolls made for models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Voice of Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, when issuing orders
stratagems.effect: One Officer unit can issue one additional order this Command phase.

stratagems.name: For the Emperor! Advance!
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, before a unit Advances
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, that unit can Advance and still shoot its ranged weapons as if it had not moved, and can still declare a Charge.

stratagems.name: Fire for Effect
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before an Artillery unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit's ranged attacks have the Indirect Fire ability and its hit rolls cannot be modified.
stratagems.restriction: Artillery units only. Cannot be used if the unit is in Engagement Range.

stratagems.name: Consolidate Squads
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: Select two friendly Infantry units within 3" of each other. Merge them into one unit with a combined model count. The merged unit uses the better Leadership and OC characteristics.
stratagems.restriction: Both units must have fewer than their starting number of models and share the same unit type

stratagems.name: Elimination Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a Skitarii unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to that Skitarii unit. Until end of phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by that Skitarii unit against that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Doctrina Imperatives
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Skitarii unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, choose one: that unit adds 1 to hit rolls for ranged attacks, OR adds 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Rad Bombardment
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 24" of a friendly Skitarii unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of that enemy unit.
stratagems.restriction: Can only affect one enemy unit per battle

stratagems.name: Binharic Override
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly Tech-Priest unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, friendly Skitarii units within 6" of that Tech-Priest re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Galvanic Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, before a Skitarii unit shoots
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, the Heavy characteristic of that unit's ranged weapons is increased by 2 and the Rapid Fire value is doubled.
stratagems.restriction: Skitarii units that have not moved this turn

stratagems.name: Unrelenting Calculation
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, that unit ignores negative modifiers to its hit rolls and adds 1 to its Strength characteristic.
